instruction: Mechanical Connector Alignment to Board Edge The file design.kicad_pcb is a 22.86 x 50.80mm Adafruit Feather form-factor board. The USB-C receptacle (J1) is currently inside the board outline. Move J1 to the correct edge-aligned corner dictated by the board outline and connector geometry, then write the result as /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. J1 must end up centered at the board corner where the top and right edges meet, with its body spanning the outline in the intended connector orientation. 2. J1 must be rotated so its mating face points outward from the board. 3. The rotation must be a multiple of 90 deg. 4. All other components (U1, C1, C2, R1, R2, J2) must remain at their original positions (within +/-0.1 mm). 5. The total component count must remain 7. Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.
